purpose: Provide the corrected immediate pre-TF58 baseline after Jan31/1Feb night-strike losses but before 2-Feb carrier/land-air suppression.
explanation: Four G4M-class aircraft were irrecoverable in the 31-Jan/1-Feb night attack; normal repair/maintenance churn prevents a mechanical 136-4 exact point but center 133 is used. Fighter strength is not charged for that raid.
water_air: about 29 serviceable water-aircraft center embedded in total before US morning attacks: Kyofu ~9, Zuiun ~6, legacy float-recon ~14.
same_day_external_reinforcement: 0 fighter aircraft credited from Truk/Ponape/Nauru/Wake. Surrounding facilities provide depth/staging, not free local CAP.
